policy: evidence-first; status is claim-specific; no promotion by numerical resemblance

assumptions: f is frequency in cycles per second.
limitations: This relation alone does not establish a biological or macroscopic coupling mechanism.
Do not confuse energy-equivalent mass with photon rest mass.

records.scope: Energy-equivalent mass obtained by combining E = h f with E = m c^2.
derivation: Rearrange to m_eq = h f / c^2.
assumptions: m_eq is an energy-equivalent quantity, not a claim of nonzero photon rest mass.
limitations: Interpretation depends on the energy-equivalence definition.

records.scope: Equal angular spacing in a fivefold rotational arrangement.
assumptions: The geometry has five equally spaced positions.
limitations: This does not imply all ATP synthase rotor rings have five subunits or a universal 72-degree mechanochemical step.

records.statement: The neutral-hydrogen ground-state hyperfine transition is approximately 1420.405752 MHz.
records.scope: Hydrogen 21 cm line; quoted frequency is rounded.
limitations: An atomic transition frequency alone establishes no coupling to biological rotors or Schumann resonances.

records.statement: The first Schumann resonance mode is commonly reported near 7.83 Hz.
records.scope: Approximate Earth-ionosphere cavity resonance; frequency and spectral peak vary with environmental and ionospheric conditions.

sources.title: Peer-reviewed geophysical literature on Schumann resonances

limitations: 7.83 Hz is not an exact universal constant or proof of a universal biological clock.

records.statement: TF1766 / Ω1766 is a project-defined model coordinate.
records.scope: Symbolic architecture and hypothesis organization; no independently established physical unit or operational measurement definition is asserted.
assumptions: Any physical interpretation requires a separately defined, falsifiable claim.
limitations: Do not treat as a fundamental physical constant or established coupling factor.

records.statement: A physically meaningful mechanism may connect fivefold rotor geometry, the neutral-hydrogen hyperfine transition, Schumann resonance modes, and a defined TF1766 model.
records.scope: Unverified; no coupling mechanism or quantitative prediction has yet been established.
records.falsification: Reject or revise if the predicted coupling is absent under calibrated tests or if a control model explains the observations equally well.
limitations: Numerical resemblance or shared vocabulary is not evidence of physical coupling.
